d: It's Ayushmann Khurrana vs Emraan Hashmi at the Bollywood Box Office! Sooraj Barjatya's family entertainer Yeh Prem Mol Liya is set to clash with Emraan Hashmi's action-packed Gunmaaster G9 on November 27. One promises romance, family drama and old-school Bollywood emotions, while the other brings action, masala, music and nostalgia. But which film will attract audiences and win the box office battle? In this episode of Samosa Critics, we (Abhishek Manchanda, Prashant Kapoor) compare Yeh Prem Mol Liya and Gunmaaster G9, discuss their trailers, music, star power, audience appeal and advance…
